title: Giving External Agents Access to Xcode
summary: Apple’s setup documentation describes the supported bridge for allowing external coding agents to use Xcode’s project-aware capabilities. It is the authoritative starting point for connecting non-Xcode clients while keeping permissions and developer control inside Apple’s tooling boundary.
takeaway: Prefer Apple’s documented access path when integrating external agents, and make its permission prompts and availability constraints explicit in team workflows.
